name: open-rl
description: OpenRL: a self-hosted, Kubernetes-native post-training API that serves the Tinker API.

plugins.name: openrl
plugins.description: Use a deployed OpenRL server from the client side: connecting, the openrl.* settings, worker lifecycle, and OpenRL's own errors. Complements the tinker-cookbook skills (research, debug), which cover how to train. The skill in skills/openrl; each release also ships it as openrl-skill.tar.gz.
